title: Novel STAT3 small-molecule inhibitors identified by structure-based virtual ligand screening incorporating SH2 domain flexibility.
authors: Kong, Ren; Bharadwaj, Uddalak; Eckols, T Kris; Kolosov, Mikhail; Wu, Haoyi; Cruz-Pavlovich, Francisco J Santa; Shaw, Alison; Ifelayo, Oluwatomilona I; Zhao, Hong; Kasembeli, Moses M; Wong, Stephen T C; Tweardy, David J
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟SH2域柔性并做虚拟筛选发现STAT3小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与MD方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA，仅方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Efforts to develop STAT3 inhibitors have focused on its SH2 domain starting with short phosphotyrosylated peptides based on STAT3 binding motifs, e.g. pY(905)LPQTV within gp130. Despite binding to STAT3 with high affinity, issues regarding stability, bioavailability, and membrane permeability of these peptides, as well as peptidomimetics such as CJ-887, have limited their further clinical development and led to interest in small-molecule inhibitors. Some small molecule STAT3 inhibitors, identified using structure-based virtual ligand screening (SB-VLS); while having favorable drug-like properties, suffer from weak binding affinities, possibly due to the high flexibility of the target domain. We conducted molecular dynamic (MD) simulations of the SH2 domain in complex with CJ-887, and used an averaged structure from this MD trajectory as an "induced-active site" receptor model for SB-VLS of 110,000 compounds within the SPEC database. Screening was followed by re-docking and re-scoring of the top 30% of hits, selection for hit compounds that directly interact with pY + 0 binding pocket residues R609 and S613, and testing for STAT3 targeting in vitro, which identified two lead hits with good activity and favorable drug-like properties. Unlike most small-molecule STAT3 inhibitors previously identified, which contain negatively-charged moieties that mediate binding to the pY + 0 binding pocket, these compounds are uncharged and likely will serve as better candidates for anti-STAT3 drug development. IMPLICATIONS: SB-VLS, using an averaged structure from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of STAT3 SH2 domain in a complex with CJ-887, a known peptidomimetic binder, identify two highly potent, neutral, low-molecular weight STAT3-inhibitors with favorable drug-like properties.
abstract_zh: 开发STAT3抑制剂的工作一直聚焦于其SH2结构域，起始于基于STAT3结合基序的短磷酸化酪氨酸肽，例如gp130内的pY(905)LPQTV。尽管这些肽与STAT3具有高亲和力结合，但其稳定性、生物利用度和膜通透性问题，以及诸如CJ-887等拟肽类化合物，限制了其进一步的临床开发，并引发了对小分子抑制剂的兴趣。一些通过基于结构的虚拟配体筛选（SB-VLS）识别出的小分子STAT3抑制剂，虽然具有有利的药物样特性，但存在结合亲和力较弱的问题，这可能归因于靶标结构域的高灵活性。我们对与CJ-887复合的SH2结构域进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟，并使用该MD轨迹的平均结构作为“诱导活性位点”受体模型，对SPEC数据库中的110,000种化合物进行SB-VLS筛选。筛选后，对前30%的命中化合物进行重新对接和重新评分，选择直接与pY + 0结合口袋残基R609和S613相互作用的命中化合物，并在体外测试其STAT3靶向性，最终鉴定出两种具有良好活性和有利药物样特性的先导化合物。与先前识别的大多数小分子STAT3抑制剂不同，这些抑制剂含有介导与pY + 0结合口袋结合的带负电荷部分，而这些化合物不带电荷，可能成为更好的抗STAT3药物开发候选物。意义：通过使用STAT3 SH2结构域与已知拟肽结合剂CJ-887复合物的分子动力学（MD）模拟平均结构进行SB-VLS，鉴定出两种高效、中性、低分子量的STAT3抑制剂，具有有利的药物样特性。
